name: Ridge Progress
description: A thin band across the top of the page with a mountain ridge in silhouette that fills with water as you read, a marker that climbs the ridgeline and a flag that waves once at the summit.

props.name: seed
props.description: Shapes the ridge. The same seed always draws the same mountains; the summit falls between 72% and 86% of the way across.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the band in pixels. The top 11 pixels are kept for the flag.

props.name: container
props.description: A scrolling element to follow instead of the window. Render the band as the first child inside that element: it then sticks to the top of the element instead of being fixed to the window, and takes its height in the flow.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the water that fills the part already read.

props.name: flagColor
props.description: Colour the summit flag takes when it is reached.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the progress bar for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the band, which is fixed to the top of the window, or sticky inside container when one is given. Other div props are passed through.
